title: Events alert — 2026-11-23
body:
**Dell Q3 FY27 earnings — Tue Nov 24, after US close (4:30 PM ET / 22:30 Berlin).**
Guidance ~$49B revenue / ~$6.50 non-GAAP EPS; the debate is conversion of the ~$95B AI-server backlog and ~18% AI server margins. First big AI-hardware read after Nvidia's -23% week (Nov 20 close). A clean backlog print supports semis/networking and the infrastructure sleeve (VRT, ANET peers); a margin miss extends the AI-unwind against today's +2-3% futures bounce.

**Context — Wed Nov 25, 08:30 ET / 14:30 Berlin: October PCE**, expected ~3.8% y/y headline (Cook estimate; Bloomberg survey). The decisive input for the Dec 8-9 FOMC where a 25bp hike is ~87% priced — supports staying in the cash sleeve until prints clear.
